_about: Scripts for the Try a sample videos. Every video is synthetic: Cloud Text-to-Speech voices (en-IN), ffmpeg gradient backgrounds and burned-in text. Brands and people are fictional. Lines are spoken in order with a short pause; overlays name the lines they span (inclusive, 0-based) or 'end'. Rebuild with tool/samples/generate.py.

borrowed.title: Clip that drops the doctor's warning
borrowed.hint: Reel cut from a 2 minute interview, stops before the doctor's condition
lines: host
Welcome back to Morning Health Chat. Today we're talking about vitamin D with Doctor Arun Mehta.
expert
Thank you for having me. It's a topic I get asked about every single week.
host
Let's start simple. Why does vitamin D matter?
expert
It helps your body absorb calcium, so it matters for bones and muscles.
host
A lot of people take a supplement every day. Should everyone?
expert
Everyone should take vitamin D daily.
expert
But only if a blood test shows you are deficient. Otherwise you can take too much and harm your kidneys.
host
So the test comes first.
expert
Exactly. Ask your doctor for a simple blood test before you start anything.
host
How do people usually get vitamin D without tablets?
expert
Sunlight is the main source. Fifteen to twenty minutes of morning sun on your arms helps most people.
host
And food?
expert
Eggs, fish and fortified milk give you some, but it's hard to get enough from food alone.
host
What happens if someone takes high doses for months without checking?
expert
Calcium can build up in the blood. That can cause nausea, weakness and kidney problems.
host
Is there a best time of day to take it, if your doctor says you need it?
expert
With a meal that has some fat in it, because vitamin D is absorbed better that way.
host
Do children need it too?
expert
Some do, but the dose is different, so that is always a question for their paediatrician.
host
And what about people who work indoors all day?
expert
They are more likely to be low, which is exactly why a test is worth doing for them.
host
How often should someone get retested?
expert
Usually after three months of treatment, then as your doctor advises.
host
That's important. Any last advice for our listeners?
expert
Get tested, follow the dose your doctor gives you, and get some sun.
host
Thank you, Doctor Mehta. That's all for today's Morning Health Chat.

declaration.caption: Doctor says everyone needs vitamin D every day #health #vitamind
